name: Richang zhi Wai
source:
One night, tossing and turning in bed, Liang Xing wondered: “If I just keep living day by day like I always do, will all my problems eventually sort themselves out?” He brushed the thought aside, content to leave it to time, when a sudden ping echoed from the phone beside his bed.

"Um... hello? I don't really know who will receive this, or if it'll even go through... So, I guess just think of this as me talking to myself..."

 Expecting a typical spam message, Liang Xing ignored it. He had no idea that his perfectly predictable life was about to take an unexpected turn.

Through Liang Xing’s eyes, players will step into the life of a young boy named Florian. Together, you will navigate the quiet rhythm of the everyday, catching glimpses of sceneries tucked away within the quiet gaps of daily life, while slowly peeling back the hidden struggles of this otherwise bright and cheerful boy.

One is searching for his father’s past; the other is finding himself. There are no grand narratives, no epic adventures—just two strangers from distant worlds quietly crossing paths, gently influencing each other, growing step by step, and learning how to live.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4572240/The_Other_Side_of_Everyday/]Steam[/url]]
